surveillanceDescription: Register cases and review epidemiological indicators.
requiredSelection: Select a valid value to continue.
invalidDate: Use a valid date between birth and care, no later than today.
queuedDescription: Saved on this device. Validation and alert assessment will run after reconnection.
offlineCapture: Use previously downloaded patients and records. Cases remain pending until validation is completed.
classificationNotice: Registration is confirmed after validating the diagnosis, laboratory evidence, duplicate records and alerts.
notificationNotice: Regulatory export to NOTI is not included in this iteration.
pendingReview: Review rejected records. A pending case has not yet completed validation.
cachedReportNotice: Previously downloaded reports may be shown. Their calculation date is displayed below.
noCases: No confirmed cases in this period.

alerts.SEVERE_CASE: Severe case: contact the epidemiology lead immediately.
alerts.DEATH: A death is recorded. Evaluate immediate notification.
alerts.ELIMINATED_FOCUS: The locality is classified as an eliminated focus.
alerts.NON_RECEPTIVE_FOCUS: The locality is classified as non-receptive.
alerts.AUTOCHTHONOUS_ELIMINATED: Autochthonous confirmed case in an eliminated focus.
alerts.EPIDEMIC_THRESHOLD: The case count crossed the Q3 epidemic threshold.
alerts.SUSTAINED_INCREASE: Case counts increased across consecutive weeks and reached Q2.
alerts.FOCUS_UNKNOWN: No focus classification is available for this locality.
alerts.PREGNANCY_UNKNOWN: Pregnancy status has not been confirmed in the source record.
alerts.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: There are not enough historical years to classify the endemic channel.
alerts.PARTIAL_PERIOD: The selected range includes partial periods; compare with caution.

errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Please try again. Pending records remain saved on this device.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Sign in again with the account that captured this record.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Your account does not have permission for this action. Contact the administrator.
errors.METADATA_NOT_CONFIGURED: Surveillance setup is incomplete. Ask the administrator to verify the clinical catalogue.
errors.ICD10_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE: The diagnosis has no unambiguous ICD-10 mapping. Ask the administrator to verify the catalogue.
errors.INVALID_CLASSIFICATION: Choose a classification available for this disease.
errors.INVALID_EVENT: Choose a disease from the surveillance catalogue.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: Select the patient and source care record again.
errors.INVALID_SOURCE_ENCOUNTER: Select a valid care record belonging to this patient and linked to a visit.
errors.INVALID_PROVIDER: Select a professional associated with your own account.
errors.INVALID_ONSET_DATE: Enter a valid symptom onset date, between birth and the source care date.
errors.DIAGNOSIS_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE: There is no diagnosis configured for this severity and species. Review the classification.
errors.LAB_RESULT_REQUIRED: Select a laboratory result before confirming or discarding the case.
errors.INVALID_LAB_RESULT: Select a valid local test for this patient, care episode and symptom onset.
errors.LAB_STATUS_CONFLICT: Case status must agree with the selected laboratory result.
errors.REQUIRED_FIELDS: Complete the required fields before registering.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_DATA: The source record contains conflicting values. Ask the clinical team to review it.
errors.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: A possible case already exists for this patient and disease. Review it with epidemiology before registering again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This record was already received with different data. Review the existing registration; do not create a duplicate.
errors.CASE_NOT_FOUND: The case could not be found.
errors.INVALID_CASE_DATA: The case is incomplete. Ask epidemiology to review its source data.
errors.INVALID_DATE_RANGE: Select a valid date range of up to two years, ending no later than today.
errors.OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: Select dates within the verified surveillance coverage.
